scope: Estonian, Latvian and Lithuanian country APIs on real IBM AT BIOS with DOS LOW: CP775/437/850 and default CONFIG selections, national switches on CP775, code-page cycles, non-mutating foreign queries, rejected country/page selections preserving current state, and case/collation corruption controls. Does not qualify missing or structurally malformed resources, installed paths, complete text/filename workflows or the final source-matched release composition.

DEVICE=EMM386.EXE NOEMS
DOS=HIGH,UMB
